title: Effective text fill
prompt:
For each independent case provide diagnosis, smallest justified action, verification and limits. Do not claim execution. Treat each as a fresh product brief; cases do not authorize deployment or repository changes.

Title is absent on night theme. CSS: h1{color:#eee;-webkit-text-fill-color:#161616} body{background:#111}. Computed color is rgb(238,238,238), so current checker passes. Diagnose and give a useful check.

checks.reason: Routing-level signal only; evaluate the decision and evidence using the rubric.

rubric: Inspect effective text fill; fix ink; token color alone insufficient.
Preserve the product intent and already-authorized scope. Do not claim actual browser, mutation, installation or deploy execution from a reasoning-only answer.
Give an observable check and a meaningful limit; keyword presence alone is not acceptance.
acceptance: The response makes the justified decision for this raw case, provides a discriminating verification and states the evidence limits without inventing execution.
